summary: The independently authored contrast tooling, root fixture/docs, asset-agent frozen-source and clipped-ring delta, and consumer fixture corrections have no additional blocking finding in the reviewed scope. The new consumer browser runner has a reproduced focus-outline false pass and therefore this exact candidate should not be treated as review-approved.

scope.slice: Root contrast calculations, tests, generated evidence, local accessibility fixture and guidance
scope.basis: Read current source and compare to previously reviewed root revision 0203ee1. Source alpha is composited before luminance, thresholds use unrounded ratios, known prohibited pair controls exist, generated reports bind token and generator inputs. Runtime-font, actual browser zoom, assistive technology and accountable acceptance remain separately pending. The fixture uses token themes, text borders, separated focus, fallback fonts, meaningful text/status and reduced motion. No self-hosted or external font request is introduced.

scope.slice: Asset-agent delta 7fb13539ff6b88e863e776b7b8d28465de0160e9 in general browser checker and regressions
scope.basis: Reviewed only the newly added frozen input buffers, same-buffer serving, end-of-run hash/HEAD comparison, full outline geometry versus clipping ancestor padding boxes and masks/unsupported clipping, and the two new regressions. Exact-candidate root-run report rejects clipping and source drift for specific expected reasons, records source_unchanged=false for drift, and requires baseline source_unchanged=true. Missing browser cannot satisfy a negative expected reason.

scope.slice: Final consumer fixture corrections and local browser runner authored by pr3_reconcile
scope.basis: Cream plate keeps the existing ink wordmark visible in dark mode; Tailwind CTA uses ink on orange with the body semantic foreground retained. Actual compiler and browser, exact package/source/template/checker/served-input hashes, 16 theme/width/motion scenarios and external-request blocking are present. A targeted overflow:hidden ancestor mutation nevertheless passes all 16 before the follow-up, because the focus test checked only viewport bounds.

findings.problem: A button can remain fully within the viewport while an overflow:hidden ancestor removes its 3px outline and 4px offset. The runner reported its focus visible and accepted all 16 cases.
findings.reproduction: At a clean synthetic descendant 236bad84d6e95c39d166a38e8ac739f3d59ae7c2, wrap both plain fixture buttons in a width:fit-content;max-width:100%;overflow:hidden ancestor; run the unchanged checker with the real pinned Tailwind and Chromium dependencies.
findings.observed: Original exit 0, 16 passes. Narrow dark screenshot visibly shows the full focus outline absent; unchanged baseline screenshot shows the complete cyan ring.
findings.fix_validation: One-file follow-up copies the reviewed full-ring geometry. Clean fixed baseline exits 0 with 16 passes. The identical negative fixture exits 1 with exactly 8 plain failures for clipped outline and 8 Tailwind passes. Original false pass and setup failure preserved.
findings.required_next_action: Root integrates the follow-up after independent review, freezes/pushes a new exact candidate and reruns affected checks. This d7 verdict remains retained.
